points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Historical recorded revision 934934ac builds and test_mesh passes; final curated source cannot configure because solver/tests is omitted, although historical commit/workspace retain it.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve/case/output, restart and report-level; max-step diagnostic override is visible and production controls remain separate.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, partition, halo, physics, reconstruction, time solver and output modules are separated; full mesh lifetime and curated tests omission remain.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal existing-solver executable invocation found; external authorship investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case settings and CGNS input paths are generic; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS, local solution/halo and rank force comparison exist, but main.cpp reads and retains full global mesh on every rank through solves.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Historical mesh test passes and M0.15 rank outputs agree; laminar short attempts and Re200 fail, and full mesh replication limits scaling.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Historical 934934ac test_mesh passes 1/1; test_numerics includes Re200 transient smoke and was not run. Tests were omitted from curated final source.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable modules and report; documented CMake requires tests absent in curated tip, and report incorrectly claims no full-mesh replication.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
